title: Soaking Hearth
pages: Craft the controller from cured hearth brick, Tempered Blackstone from the Basalt Temperer, nether bricks, plain blackstone and a furnace. Place a blackstone block directly beneath it and iron bars directly above it. Wall all four horizontal sides with nether bricks.

Right-click the formed controller while holding one full soaking recipe batch. It loads the stock buffer; after 40 ticks, right-click with an empty hand to collect the product. A short batch or full stock buffer leaves your held items intact. A missing blackstone base, iron bars cap, or any open nether brick wall stops operation.

It runs 20 exclusive datapack soaking recipes; JEI shows each batch size. Four iron, gold or copper ingots soak into one Soaked Billet. Four raw iron or raw copper roast into three grit; four raw gold or one gold block yield gilded blackstone (1 or 2). An iron block draws seven chains, and a copper block weathers to exposed copper. Blaze powder (2) or a blaze rod makes three fire charges, four magma cream render two slime balls, four nether brick fire into cracked nether bricks and four quartz into smooth quartz. Four amethyst shards fuse into tinted glass, six glowstone dust into shroomlight, four redstone into glowstone dust and four lapis into blue glazed terracotta. Two diamonds seed a budding amethyst, and four netherite scrap press a netherite upgrade template. Every route is lossy; hold the batch and right-click, or automate as below.

Soak an iron ingot into a Soaked Billet to replace one of the Quench Vat's four iron ingot corners. This makes the Soaking Hearth the third required t1 apparatus alongside the Kiln and Quench Vat; a bare iron ingot in that corner no longer satisfies the vat's craft.

For automation, insert valid soaking stock into the controller from any face except the bottom and extract products from the bottom; reach these covered faces through Stock Hatches. Each formed batch takes 40 ticks; a missing blackstone base, iron bars cap or nether brick wall pauses processing without consuming stock. The controller buffers one input stack and one output stack, saves both and its face modes, and exposes Forge item handlers to hoppers or pipes; stock with no matching recipe is refused. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to cycle the clicked face through input, output and disabled; right-click with an empty hand to collect buffered output. It has no FE or fluid port. Matching ties resolve by resource ID.

Stock Hatches: every face of this controller is covered by a frame part, so hoppers and pipes reach it through Stock Hatches. Place a hatch instead of any part that touches the controller face-to-face; at most two hatches may stand in, and a third breaks formation. A hatch relays only while the frame is formed, and it relays the controller face it covers: insert stock into a hatch on an In face, and extract products from a hatch whose face you sneak-use with an empty hand to cycle to Out (the base face starts as Out). For example, swap one side part for a hatch fed by a hopper pointing into it from beside, and swap the base part for a hatch with a hopper beneath it. A hopper touching a redstone block or other powered part is locked by vanilla rules. Right-clicking a hatch with an empty hand collects the product buffer.
